en-US.name: LightTable
en-US.releaseNotes:
LightTable 0.7.11
This point release adds a direct way for Windows users to review LightTable in the Microsoft Store and a restrained, dismissible reminder after successful exports. It also includes release-process fixes merged since 0.7.10.

What's New
- Microsoft Store review action on Windows: Open Help and choose Write a Microsoft Store review… to reach LightTable's Store review page. After three successful exports over at least seven days, LightTable may show a small review reminder. No thanks dismisses future reminders; the Help action remains available. The reminder is not shown during an update offer or another dialog.
- Release maintenance: The build fingerprint now accepts changes to the macOS update-feed URL without forcing an unnecessary full rebuild. Release-process documentation clarifies the GitHub Latest badge and local checkout synchronization.

Installation
Download the asset for your platform from this release or follow the installation instructions:
- Windows x64: use the signed setup executable for installation or the ZIP for portable use. Direct installer updates belong to the app; Scoop updates belong to Scoop. For Scoop: scoop bucket add lighttable https://github.com/reville/scoop-lighttable, then scoop install lighttable.
- Linux x86_64: use the portable archive on Ubuntu 24.04 or newer. Follow the Linux installation instructions for supported packages and update ownership.
- macOS Apple silicon: the separate 0.7.11-beta.1 release requires macOS 14 or newer. The beta is ad-hoc signed and may need Open Anyway at first launch; the notarized 0.7.6 download remains the default. For Homebrew: brew tap reville/lighttable, then brew trust --cask reville/lighttable/lighttable@beta on Homebrew 6+, and brew install --cask reville/lighttable/lighttable@beta. Use Homebrew to update a Homebrew installation; manual DMG installations require manual replacement.
- npm CLI installer: npm install -g lighttable-digital-darkroom@0.7.11, then lighttable install. The package is published and downloads the verified Windows installer. See CLI installation for desktop installation options.
Physical Windows GPU/display coverage remains experimental. The Microsoft Store has its own review and update process; this GitHub release does not by itself update the Store listing.

What's Changed
- Record Windows and Linux 0.7.10 publication and metadata by @reville in #203
- Allow SUFeedURL updates in build fingerprint version check by @reville in #204
- Document GitHub Latest release badge handoff and local sub-repo sync in release process by @reville in #205
- Add Windows Store review action and restrained reminder by @reville in #206
- Prepare LightTable 0.7.11 point release by @reville in #207
